newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midwest power eases on milder weather outlook.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midwest power eases on milder weather outlook.

text.p: Spot wholesale electricity prices in the midwestern U.S. turned mostly softer Friday ahead of the weekend as forecasters called for milder temperatures this weekend and into next week, sources said.

In the East Central Area Coordination Agreement (ECAR) district, peak, non-firm electricity prices for Saturday delivery were discussed at $14.00-$16.00 a megawatt hour (MWh) area, as compared with the $16.00-17.00 range on Thursday.
